title: Admissions publishing and recruitment measurement
not_questions: The university will not license Adobe Target.
Use synthetic applicant identifiers in every demonstration.
Submit all prices in US dollars.

questions.label: A.1
questions.text: Describe how AEM Sites would let each of our eleven faculties own its course descriptions while keeping the central admissions office in control of deadlines, tuition notices and legal copy. Include the changes an editor could make alone and the record an approver would see before publication.

questions.label: A.2
questions.text: Explain how you would move the course directory from Sitecore into AEM Sites before the autumn prospectus goes to print. Account for old course codes, duplicate departmental pages and two language variants, and identify a reconciliation check the registrar can sign.

questions.label: A.3
questions.text: Show how AEM Sites would handle a scholarship deadline corrected after an email has already gone out. Cover the landing page, cached copies and links retained by counselors, then specify what the admissions desk can use to confirm the correction.

questions.label: A.4
questions.text: Provide a rehearsal plan for the AEM Sites cutover during the exam period. Identify who can halt the change if course links fail and how the faculty editors would return to the last approved directory without losing later corrections.

questions.label: B.1
questions.text: Describe how Customer Journey Analytics would distinguish a campus tour registration from an actual visit when a prospective student registers twice.

questions.label: B.2
questions.text: Explain how attendance files in Snowflake would enter Customer Journey Analytics and how staff would see a count of records rejected because their campus code has expired.

questions.label: B.3
questions.text: Show how Customer Journey Analytics would report inquiry to application rates when one student requests details from three faculties during the same term.

questions.label: B.4
questions.text: Provide a Customer Journey Analytics acceptance exercise that exposes an accidental double count after a tour organizer resubmits last month's attendance.

questions.label: C.1
questions.text: Name the supplier's proposed faculty liaison and give the number of days that person can attend our campus during term time.

questions.label: C.2
questions.text: Provide two university client references willing to discuss decentralised editorial governance and the workload involved in training visiting lecturers.

questions.label: C.3
questions.text: Describe your firm's arrangements for replacing a delivery lead who leaves between prospectus approval and the new intake.

questions.label: C.4
questions.text: Itemize your firm's travel charges and state which trips are included in the fixed fee for the admissions pilot.
